title: Stylish Music City Stay• King Bed + Free Parking!
description:
Whether you're in Nashville for concerts, a Vanderbilt visit, birthdays, or a weekend exploring Broadway, my stylish home is designed to make your trip easy, comfortable, and memorable. Spend the day downtown, then come home to cozy beds, a fully stocked kitchen, fast Wi-Fi, and a relaxing space to unwind with your group.

The space
Our home comfortably sleeps up to 7 guests and is designed with both quality and cleanliness as our top priorities.

✦ WHY GUESTS LOVE IT ✦
• 5 minutes to Broadway & downtown
• King bed + quality linens
• Free parking
• Fenced yard
• Smart TVs + fast Wi-Fi
• Coffee bar + stocked kitchen
• Washer & dryer
• Self check-in with keypad
• Professionally cleaned
• Family-owned & thoughtfully designed

Please Note: This property has two separate units. Your unit is completely private with its own entrance, and there are no shared spaces or access between units, ensuring a peaceful and private experience for guests.

⟡ Bedrooms ⟡
•	2 bedrooms, each with comfortable beds and quality linens 
•	Clean, quiet spaces designed for cozy, restful sleep

⟡ Living Area ⟡ 
•	Bright living room with beautiful natural light 
•	Comfortable seating and a pull-out couch for additional sleeping space
•	40” Smart TV with streaming capability
•	Washer & Dryer

⟡ Additional Sleeping ⟡ 
•	Pull-out couch included
•	Optional air mattress available for an additional fee
•	Baby Pack-N-Play included

⟡  Kitchen & Amenities ⟡ 
The kitchen is fully stocked with essential cooking supplies, making it easy to prepare meals or enjoy a relaxed breakfast before heading out to explore Nashville.
•	Coffee bar
•	Cooking spices
•	Light snacks

⟡ Location – Close to Everything ⟡ 
One of the best parts of this home is its easy access to Nashville’s top destinations.

 → 5 minutes
•	Broadway Honky Tonks
•	Tootsies Orchid Lounge

 → 10 minutes
•	Bridgestone Arena
•	Ryman Auditorium

 → 15 minutes
•	The Parthenon
•	Vanderbilt University
•	Centennial Park

 → Other nearby favorites
•	Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum
•	Nissan Stadium
•	The Gulch
•	12 South

Located downtown, the home offers quick access to Broadway, concerts, restaurants, and Nashville nightlife while still giving guests a quieter place to recharge after a busy day exploring the city.
